premises.text: Many heart-attack deaths occur before hospital arrival, so time to medical treatment is critical
premises.evidence_span: 50% of the people who died from a heart attack died before arriving to a hospital

premises.text: A small SmartHeart device plus smartphone app lets non-professionals run a hospital-grade 12-lead ECG anywhere in about 30 seconds
premises.evidence_span: within 30 seconds, I will be able to perform a hospital-grade full ECG exam

premises.text: ECG results can be viewed on the phone and sent to doctors, PHR, or hospital by email or fax
premises.evidence_span: you can send the ECG to any third party

premises.text: Device is priced around $499 with free apps and monthly or pay-per-use service packages

value.text: Anyone can raise survival chances by getting hospital-grade ECG anytime, anywhere
value.evidence_span: significantly increase the chances of surviving a heart attack

secondary_value.text: Better healthcare and quality of living for families
secondary_value.evidence_span: your families and your loved ones will enjoy better health care and quality of living

causal_links.evidence_span: Time is the most crucial factor in cardiac events
The sooner you'll be in a hospital getting medical treatment, the higher your chances to survive
You can use it on a monthly service packages or alternatively on a pay-per-use model

notes: Size/weight, connectivity indicators, and 12-lead detail folded into the portable ECG mechanism (feature cascade). Market epidemiology stats treated as framing, not separate premises. Singleton D1/D3: time-criticality diagnosis and commercial packaging are separately revisable from the device mechanism. P3 kept as send/share path that could fail independently of recording.
